messages:
Alex (presales): Borealis Bank wants a short POC: streaming + function calls + strict JSON schema. They need ephemeral token rotation, CMEK questions, and a pricing sketch for ~80k req/day. Who can take handoff?
Dev (eng): I can do SDK samples. Which transport: SSE or WS? WS preferred for tool-call replies.
Alex (presales): WS. They also asked about session resume after network flakiness.
Pri (solutions): Session resume supported via resume_token and KV-cache resume. If client supplies resume_token on reconnect, we replay unused KV entries. Will document expected semantics.
Kim (security): For CMEK: Hosted supports CMEK for enterprise accounts (procurement and SOC2 required). Private supports customer KMS/HSM directly. Need their KMS vendor + key policy for our security review.
Nora (sales-ops): Pricing: rough hosted estimate $6k-$14k/mo depending on model family and tokens. Dedicated node pricing drops unit cost; can include 30-day POC credit. Will include eu pricing and egress.
Dev (eng): Minimal WS auth example: ```
// Authorization header with ephemeral token
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${EPHEMERAL}` } });
ws.send(JSON.stringify({type: 'handshake', client_id: 'borealis-poc'}));
```
Pri (solutions): For structured output fallback: 1) enforce JSON schema server-side, 2) on parse fail return {"error":"schema","hint":"expected field 'tx_amount'"}, 3) auto-retry once with schema hint, 4) final fallback include raw text in error payload.
Dev (eng): Heartbeat suggestion for long-lived sessions: app-level ping every 5m, WS ping/pong 30s. If idle >15m close with resumable token.
Kim (security): Action: Borealis to send SAML metadata + KMS vendor and key usage policy. Also we require completed vendor security questionnaire.
infra-bot: streaming-handler v2 deployed to eu-west-1, health checks passing.
Alex (presales): Timeline: Dev to post sample repo + resume example Tue EOD, Pri to post schema templates and retry policy, Nora to share pricing/PO template Wed AM, Kim to follow up on questionnaire. I'll loop in Borealis for SAML/KMS.
Pri (solutions): I'll add success metrics: schema pass >= 99%, toolcall roundtrip <300ms p95, session-resume verified in reconnect tests.
Nora (sales-ops): Will include bandwidth assumptions and a dedicated vs hosted cost comparison.
Alex (presales): Thanks team — will update Borealis after we have the sample.
